column1: # Route × role expectation table (NFR-02, ADR 0002). One line per mapped route of the app:
# METHOD  PATTERN  anonymous  CUSTOMER  OPERATOR  ADMIN  — expected status, "|" for alternatives.
# ANY means the mapping accepts every method (tested with GET). Path variables are replaced by
# "1" and "/**" by "/x". A mapped route missing here, or a line without a mapping, fails the test.
# auth module (ADR 0003, ADR 0004): sign-in entries, link pages and the Phase 1 stub homes.
# customers module (CUS-02, CUS-06): registration behind a REGISTER link (the controller checks the token or the session), profile.
# ENH-07 address book in the profile (ADR 0033): 404 for a customer while customers.addressBook is off, as in this run.
# orders module (CUS-04, CUS-05, CUS-07): list, detail, the new-order form and the changes to a pending order behind a customer session.
# ENH-07 «Ordina di nuovo» (ADR 0033): 404 while orders.repeat is off; without a CSRF token every POST is 403.
# backoffice module (ADM-02…ADM-09, ADM-11, ADM-12, NFR-03; ADR 0017, 0028): staff screens, record editing; settings, staff users and privacy tools for ADMIN only.
# ADR 0035 office tools: 404 for staff while admin.exports / orders.bulkTracking are off, as in this run.
# A record that can no longer be changed (an anonymised customer; an order already closed, or approved for an OPERATOR)
# sends staff back to its page with a message (302); which one the sample id 1 is depends on the tests run before.
# ADR 0036 website requests: 404 for staff while leads.inbox is off, as in this run.
# reports module (ADM-09, ADR 0016): the two authenticated downloads (sample id 1 may or may not be a run: 404, or the PDF for staff and 403 for a customer it is not about)
# site module (ADR 0012, 0013, 0014): the public pages of chapter 06 §3.1, the generated files, the form endpoint.
# POST /api/form without Origin or Referer is refused by the controller's own check (ADR 0014)
# tracking module (ADR 0010, 0011): the kept legacy endpoints and the 410 catch-all
